notes: Official librime 1.17.0 Windows-msvc artifacts from rime/librime.
The MSVC rime.dll statically includes librime-lua (Lua 5.4.8) and OpenCC.
The archive does not ship OpenCC conversion tables; RIMES copies those from rime-data/opencc when assembling a shared-data tree.
The archive does not ship a separate rime-lua.dll. Product rime_ice lua scripts still need the RIMES rime-data lua tree on a real install.
CI typing tests use the isolated lua-free testdata/e2e schema, not rime_ice.
